'''Imperial Navy Deepdock Facility Two''' was an [[Imperial Navy]] [[deepdock]] that remained in fixed [[orbit]] above the [[planet]] [[Carida]].<ref name="Tarkin" /> It was active in [[14 BBY]],<ref name="Tarkin date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] to [[14 BBY]].</ref> and acted as a [[staging area]] for the [[Conquest (Secutor-class)|''Conquest''{{'s}}]] attempt to [[blockade]] the ''[[Carrion Spike]]''.<ref name="Tarkin" />
